ascendant_in_sign.Mesha: Mesha (Aries) Ascendant: Bold, pioneering, and action-oriented. You lead from the front and prefer to initiate rather than follow.
ascendant_in_sign.Vrishabha: Vrishabha (Taurus) Ascendant: Steady, patient, and comfort-loving. You build slowly and value stability, beauty, and material security.
ascendant_in_sign.Mithuna: Mithuna (Gemini) Ascendant: Curious, communicative, and versatile. You learn quickly, talk well, and prefer variety over routine.
ascendant_in_sign.Karka: Karka (Cancer) Ascendant: Nurturing, sensitive, and protective. You lead with emotion, care deeply for family, and value emotional security.
ascendant_in_sign.Simha: Simha (Leo) Ascendant: Regal, confident, and generous. You seek recognition, lead with dignity, and have natural authority.
ascendant_in_sign.Kanya: Kanya (Virgo) Ascendant: Analytical, service-minded, and precise. You notice details others miss and prefer order and usefulness.
ascendant_in_sign.Tula: Tula (Libra) Ascendant: Diplomatic, relationship-oriented, and fair. You seek balance, harmony, and are naturally charming.
ascendant_in_sign.Vrischika: Vrischika (Scorpio) Ascendant: Intense, private, and transformative. You probe beneath the surface and prefer depth over small talk.
ascendant_in_sign.Dhanu: Dhanu (Sagittarius) Ascendant: Philosophical, optimistic, and freedom-loving. You seek meaning, teach naturally, and value truth.
ascendant_in_sign.Makara: Makara (Capricorn) Ascendant: Ambitious, disciplined, and responsible. You climb steadily, value structure, and take duty seriously.
ascendant_in_sign.Kumbha: Kumbha (Aquarius) Ascendant: Humanitarian, original, and group-oriented. You think differently, value community, and resist convention.
ascendant_in_sign.Meena: Meena (Pisces) Ascendant: Compassionate, imaginative, and spiritual. You feel deeply, dream vividly, and serve quietly.
